description: Elections Commission - A. M. Premachandra of the Mahaoya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Mahaoya Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This is a declaration made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the status of an elected official, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
